description.en:
Search boxes right on the shop, construction and map screens. Click the box and type: results update as you type, no pop-up needed. Includes Where's My Stuff.
Shop: - In a category or brand list, typing filters that list. - On the category, brand, pack and DLC tiles, typing searches the whole shop and lists every match. - Searches name, brand, category, DLC, mod name and mod author. Every word must match: "fendt 700", "john deere tedder". - Horsepower and price: hp>200, 200-300hp, 250hp, $<50k, $100k-200k, $144,500. Mix with words: "fendt hp>300 $<400k".
Construction: - Typing filters the buildings in every category and tab.
Map (Where's My Stuff): - Type in the box at the top of the map (or press Ctrl+F) to find vehicles, bales, pallets, big bags, buildings and fields. Vehicles are also found by license plate. - Every match gets a big arrow that shrinks down onto it. Enter centers the map on the nearest one.
Enter or clicking elsewhere keeps the search, Esc clears it. In the shop and construction screens going back, switching tabs or closing the screen clears it too.
Console commands (development build): wmsSummary - totals per fill type wmsList <fillType> - every item of that fill type and where it is wmsLeftovers - bales and pallets lying on fields wmsShow <fillType|ALL|LEFTOVERS|EMPTY> - mark items on the in-game map (map filter "Other") wmsGoto <fillType|ALL|LEFTOVERS|EMPTY> - mark items and set the nearest one as your map target wmsHide - remove the map markers wmsFind <text> - same search as the map, listed nearest first wmsTarget <number> - navigate to that numbered marker searchablesDumpUi - print the element tree of the open screen searchablesMove shop|construction dx dy - nudge a search box by some pixels
